description: Poly split for the MixMaster inserts and direct outs, breaking a sixteen-channel cable into eight stereo pairs of mono outputs, with a thru output carrying the poly signal onward

inputs.text: The sixteen-channel signal split across the mono outputs

outputs.text: Carries a copy of the poly input
Carries the left channel of that track from the poly input
Carries the right channel of that track from the poly input

notes: the panel choice only relabels the jacks; it changes nothing about what the module does with them.
menu: Panel — relabels the jacks for tracks 1-8, tracks 9-16 or the group and aux busses
